title: 549 of 617 open checklist rows (and 272 of 287 landed_unproven) carry no due_by, so the daily review's 'due_by passed' sweep never surfaces them
note: DEEP-AUDIT-20261104 (docs/reviews/2026-11-04-weekly-audit.md). MEASURED via checklist_store.load_path, 1274 rows: open (queued/in_flight/landed_unproven/blocked) 617, with due_by 68, past due 12. All 10 AUD-20261028 rows had no due_by and 0 of 10 changed state in 7 d (9 queued). Manager SKILL 'audit-outcome contract' (11-01) requires owner+due_by+roadmap. This audit set due_by on every AUD row it touched. Fix (Tier 1): checklist.py add refuses an AUD-*/review row without --due-by (the contract already binds; operator OK needed only if read as a gate), plus the drain lane re-dates the rest. DETECTOR: checklist.py --check count of open rows without due_by, reported in brief section 1. CHECK: {command: count open rows without due_by, rule: falls week on week, resolves_when: < 100}. next_action: ask_operator only on the add-refusal (No new gates).
